Why KabatOne

Real work, real consequences

Genuinely mission-critical

Emergency dispatch, video, GIS and sensors in real time. If the system stalls, somebody waits longer for an ambulance. That changes how you design.

Israel and Mexico

R&D in Israel, development and operations in Mexico, commercial office in New Jersey. Distributed teams shipping to 10+ countries.

AI-native engineering

We work spec-first, with coding agents under human review and explicit gates. AI does the mechanical work; people decide.

Real ownership

Small teams, large scope. You make architecture decisions that outlive years of features — and you sign your name to them.
